desktop_validation.meaning: 45 JVM and 18 Python tests passed; the packaged JAR smoke passed on desktop. This does not pass an iOS device gate.

packaged_reference_suite.meaning: The original unchanged 25 cases and JavaBeans functional probe now pass in the exported physical-device report. Broader G3 conversions remain partial.

environment.user_reported_iphone_os: Device report: iOS 27.0.1; minimum iOS18 requirement met
environment.ios_device_validation_route: Self-signed user-operated iPhone; exported build6 report proves actual JVM startup and the included fixture passed. User explicitly confirmed a normal Home Screen launch on a non-jailbroken phone without debugger or extra JIT activation.
environment.macos_build_route: SSH tags start GitHub macOS builds; run39044188251 built both slices, passed ten exports and the Simulator fixture, and produced the matched unsigned build6 IPA.
environment.meaning: Windows PC and iPhone/iPad, no local Mac. Physical-device runtime report plus explicit launch-condition confirmation pass G1 and G2. G3-G5 retain uncovered requirements; full feature migration is not allowed yet.

inventory_checks.scope: Archive identity, deterministic inventory, evidence anchors, bounded reads and malformed-input rejection; no runtime compatibility claim.

gates.required_evidence: Signed iPhone app starts JVM after debugger disconnect and relaunch, without JIT or jailbreak.
gates.observation: Matching Release build6 report shows successful cold JVM creation and fixture execution on iPhone. The user explicitly confirmed direct Home Screen launch without debugger, extra JIT activation or jailbreak.

gates.required_evidence: Locked engine loads on device; actual E4X and Java interop calls prove required XML/beans classes work.
gates.observation: Physical-device report matches build6 source and JAR; htmlunit-core-js5.3.0-legado.4 on interpreted OpenJDK Zero executes E4X, Java interop and JavaBeans getter/setter discovery/read/write. Thirteen packaged modules match the validated manifest.

gates.required_evidence: Original semantics cases pass on the iOS JVM including this/eval/Function/scope/E4X/Java wrapping/overloads.
gates.observation: All 25 unchanged original engine cases and the JavaBeans probe pass on the device. Exhaustive Java collections, byte arrays, type conversion and overload-selection comparisons remain pending.

gates.required_evidence: On-device reference comparison covers search/details/TOC/content, pure JS, login and batch content, including requests and state effects.
gates.observation: Physical fixed mainJs login/search/details/TOC/content/batch/state fixture passes; all eight requests and normalized state match the Simulator. The Simulator uses the same port; independent Android-original golden traces remain pending.

gates.required_evidence: On-device cancellation, timeout, browser cancellation, isolation and repeated-run results with measured performance.
gates.observation: Single-device timings/RSS and host-handshake cancellation pass. The handshake does not prove entry into the CPU loop before cancellation; network/browser timeouts and cancellation, concurrency isolation and sustained sessions remain pending.

device_metrics.measurement_note: Single synthetic run with diagnostic I/O. Cold app launch and app size increase remain unmeasured; latency values are one sample per operation, not percentiles.
